basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Copenhagen with a passion for exploring new technologies and languages. Outside of work, I enjoy watching survival shows like 'Naked and Afraid' and have recently started learning Danish to connect more with the local culture. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 8-10 PM CET. Currently single, I spend my weekends hiking and experimenting with new recipes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having earned my degree from a well-known European university. My interest in technology has led me to continuously explore new browsers and software, which is how I discovered Vivaldi. I often delve into forums and online resources to stay updated on tech trends.
